summary: The ServiceCode class manages service codes within the HSPnet.DataLayer namespace. It includes properties for code identifiers, names, and associated categories with localization support for alternate languages.
purpose: To represent and manage service codes used in various contexts such as courses and timetables.

entities.name: ServiceCode
entities.description: Represents a service code with properties for ID, ShortName, Name, and localization options.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Identifier for the code category associated with the service code.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short name or abbreviation for the service code.
